title: Generated topology and sheaf criterion for the twisted category
statement: For C,J,s as in [def-sf-twisted-action-presentation-data], transport the topology of the generic integer-action category to the category in [lem-sf-twisted-action-category]. This topology is exactly the infimum of topologies containing the images of all J-covering sieves. The degree-zero inclusion is continuous and cocontinuous, and a presheaf is a sheaf precisely when its degree-zero restriction is a J-sheaf, also for commutative-ring-valued presheaves.

source.place: Original twisted-site steps 1, 2, and the coefficient part of step 4. Agent variant motivated by Tag 00W0 (proposition-sheaves-on-group), not a claim that that tag proves the twisted assertion.

proof.text: Every integer power of s is continuous by composition in the positive and negative directions. Cover preservation and the inverse-power equivalence imply preservation and reflection of covering presieves.

Transport the existing integerActionTopology across the equivalence between the two object copies. Its universal property proves equality with the infimum of topologies generated by the prescribed sieves.

Apply the integer-action covering and sheaf criterion and transport it across the object-copy equivalence. The cover criterion gives cocontinuity; the sheaf criterion gives continuity and, by testing Hom-valued presheaves, the ring-valued sheaf criterion.

    letI := category s
